text.tspan: weight 1 nA: relays every spike of S0 to M0
weight 700 pA·p0: relays S0's spikes to M1 while p0 is high
weight 700 pA·p1: relays S1's spikes to M0 while p1 is high
weight 1 nA: relays every spike of S1 to M1
above 0.5 V, H1 draws current out of S0
above 0.5 V, H0 draws current out of S1
transconductance amplifier: output current I_b·tanh(V+ − V−), I_b its bias current;
"σ": a sigmoid, an amplifier plus a constant current
capacitor: a node's charge (with a follower before it: a low-pass filter, τ)
controlled current source: its current is set by the voltage on its dashed line; the arrow is its direction
fixed voltage: a reference for an amplifier's input
control line: sets a value, carries no current (round everything: the brain's boundary)
junction: wires meeting at a dot are joined; wires crossing without one are not
shaded box: one part of the brain, titled with what it does
E0 holds how much more S0 has spiked lately than S1. A good taste raises p0, a bad one lowers it, each as fast as E0 allows.
E1 holds how much more S1 has spiked lately than S0. A good taste raises p1, a bad one lowers it, each as fast as E1 allows.
the brain: everything inside this line; the body connects only at the terminals ○

The designed circuit: four neurons (sensors S0, S1; motors M0, M1), four synapses (two fixed, two that learn), two hush cells by which each sensor quiets the other, two learning cells and the taste. Each shaded box is one of these parts, titled with what it does.

Each triangle is a transconductance amplifier, output current I_b·tanh(V+ − V−); followers with a capacitor are low-pass filters. Nodes N1–N19; ground is 0 V. Values in SI (units.py); a tick of the world is 10 ms.

Shown: S0 relays every spike to M0 and S1 to M1 (each sensor's side is a coin toss at birth). The body decides what each sensor sees, which thruster each motor fires, and the taste when a block touches the mouth: one input, saying nothing of which sensor saw it.
NEURON S0: a sensor, spikes when it sees colour 0
NEURON S1: a sensor, spikes when it sees colour 1
NEURON M0: a motor, each spike fires a thruster
NEURON M1: a motor, each spike fires a thruster
TASTE: one input for both learning cells
HUSH CELL H1: S1 quiets S0
HUSH CELL H0: S0 quiets S1
LEARNING CELL 0: sets p0, the weight of S0 → M1
LEARNING CELL 1: sets p1, the weight of S1 → M0
